title: Technology primary: an unaffordable second technology
description: The Technology strategy card's primary researches one technology free and a second for 6 resources. With 4 resources the modal still let a player pick a second card, then showed a disabled "Confirm Research (2 Techs - 6 resources)" without saying why (and replaced the second pick on every further click). Now, once a first technology is picked and the player cannot pay 6, every other card is dimmed with the reason (tooltip and aria description), a hint next to "Selected" says what to do, and Confirm stays enabled for the single free pick. With 6 resources two picks work as before, and a "Clear second pick" button (44 px) takes the second one back. Before shots are taken on the commit without the fix; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BT. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; the viewer has no planets, so its resources are its trade goods.

shots.caption: The other cards are dimmed (hover or screen reader: "Second technology costs 6 resources, you have 4"), the hint reads "A second technology costs 6 (you have 4). Pick one technology or gain resources.", and Confirm Research (1 Tech - Free) stays enabled.

notes.title: Where the 6 comes from
notes.text: The engine asks for the second technology in a separate decision after the first is answered (strategy_cards.rs, paid_research with TECHNOLOGY_PRIMARY_SECOND_COST = 6), so the price is not on the first decision's options. The modal mirrors it as a constant. The secondary's 4 is read from the option's payload cost when present. Discounts that apply only at payment time (Doctor Sucaban, Deepwrought's commander, Specialist Compounds) are not known to the modal, so a seat that could only afford the second technology through one of them is shown one pick.

notes.title: Hyper Metabolism
notes.text: A technology that only becomes valid through the first pick's track (it is not in the engine's first list) is still selectable as a second pick. One that was valid already but is missing from the engine's list is not.

notes.title: Smoke harness
notes.text: A selected tech card (data-selected) and the Clear second pick control count as take-back controls, so random and steered play can back out of such a state.
